definition: Sales revenue is the order subtotal: the sum of sales.salesorderheader.subtotal, which excludes tax and freight.
The full amount a customer owes for an order, including tax and freight: sales.salesorderheader.totaldue.
Revenue of individual order lines, used for revenue by product, subcategory or category: quantity times unit price after the line discount.
sqlHint: sum(sod.orderqty * sod.unitprice * (1 - sod.unitpricediscount)) FROM sales.salesorderdetail sod

definition: The number of product units ordered: the sum of sales.salesorderdetail.orderqty.
The average subtotal per sales order (tax and freight excluded).
An order the customer placed on the website (sales channel 'online'); orders with the flag off were placed by a sales person for a reseller store.
A customer who is a person buying for themselves: a sales.customer row with no store.
A reseller customer, i.e. a bike shop that buys from the company: a sales.customer row linked to a store. Also called reseller.
A customer with at least one order in the 12 months up to the latest order date in the data (the data ends in mid-2025, so the current date is not used).
sqlHint: soh.orderdate > (SELECT max(o.orderdate) FROM sales.salesorderheader o) - interval '12 months'

definition: The company's fiscal year runs from July 1 to June 30 and is named after the calendar year in which it ends (fiscal year 2025 = July 2024 to June 2025).
The territory group of a sales territory: North America, Europe or Pacific.
The top level of the product hierarchy (Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories). Products link to a subcategory, which links to the category.
sqlHint: production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid

definition: A product that is no longer sold: it has a sell end date. Products still for sale have none. The discontinueddate column is empty; do not use it.
A product that can be sold to customers, as opposed to a part used only in manufacturing.
The difference between a product's list price and its standard cost.
sqlHint: p.listprice - p.standardcost FROM production.product p WHERE p.finishedgoodsflag

definition: The department an employee works in now: the department history row without an end date.
sqlHint: humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL

definition: A supplier the purchasing department prefers to buy from.
